candidates.name: West-East 1 Oil Pipeline
candidates.from: Jebel Dhanna / western & offshore Abu Dhabi oil fields (Upper Zakum, Das Blend, Umm Lulu crude streams feed in near Habshan)

evidence.note: UAE Crown Prince directs ADNOC to accelerate the 'West-East Pipeline project'; targets 2027 operation; doubles Fujairah export capacity.

Explicitly describes a new parallel line distinct from ADCOP: ~300 km, $3bn, 50% complete, targeting early-2027; doubles bypass capacity from ~1.8 to 3+ Mbpd; carries Upper Zakum, Das Blend and Umm Lulu crude streams offshore/western Abu Dhabi fields to Fujairah without transiting the Gulf.

Earliest sighting (Oct 2024): new pipeline (not an expansion of existing ADCOP) roughly doubling Habshan-Fujairah transfer capacity; new segment sized at 48-inch, 1.5m bpd; route Jebel Dhanna -> Habshan -> Fujairah; combined capacity to Fujairah ~3.3m bpd once complete.

Names it the 'Dhanna-Fujairah crude oil pipeline', a new physical line, ~310 miles, $3bn cost, 50% complete as of May 2026, targeting 2027; explicitly UAE's 'second' Hormuz-bypass pipeline after the original Habshan-Fujairah (ADCOP) line.
Confirms sponsor ADNOC, Habshan-Fujairah corridor, ~1.5m bpd added capacity, 2027 target, described as a second/new pipeline (not just debottlenecking).
Independent trade-press corroboration of the same project, capacity doubling and 2027 target.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster. The roster's only Habshan-Fujairah line is P0553 (Bab-Habshan-Fujairah Oil Pipeline aka ADCOP), status=operating, len=406.0, dia=48, cap=1,800,000 — built 2008-2012. West-East 1 is described across independent sources as a second, physically distinct 48-inch line running parallel/alongside ADCOP on a similar Abu Dhabi-to-Fujairah corridor (with a Jebel Dhanna-side offshore-crude tie-in) adding ~1.5m bpd of new capacity, first sanctioned/reported ~Oct 2024, under active construction (~50% complete May 2026), targeting 2027 startup, $3bn cost. This is additive new pipe, not a capacity upgrade of the existing 1.8m bpd ADCOP line, so it should be staged as a genuine new_row rather than folded into P0553. Route/length reporting varies by outlet (~300 km vs ~310 miles/~500 km vs 'more than 360 km') and should be resolved during route research before finalizing GEM fields; capacity is consistently reported as ~1.5m bpd added (bringing combined Fujairah throughput to ~3.3m bpd).
